extension.summary: Smooth Prime: Prime Video in the Aurora Cinema interface
extension.description: Smooth Prime is maintained by AgreeWithScotty. Catalog, account authentication, HTTPS transport, media resources, Widevine license relay, subtitles and playback lifecycle use independently written implementations. The dedicated Aurora interface is adapted from Scott's SmoothFlix. Not affiliated with Amazon. See NOTICE.md for asset and dependency licenses.
extension.disclaimer: Uses your own Amazon account and Kodi InputStream Adaptive with Widevine. Not affiliated with Amazon.
extension.news: 0.2.38[CR]- Apply one HTTPS-only TLS policy across sign-in, authorization, catalog, artwork, media and update requests.[CR]- Require certificate/hostname verification and TLS 1.2 or newer; do not inherit environment proxies or write TLS debug traffic keys.[CR]- Remove the non-Windows credential TCP listener and use an owner-only private filesystem socket with mutual authentication.[CR]- Refuse credential operations when private IPC is unavailable, without a TCP fallback.[CR]- Discard invalid or unprotectable legacy plaintext credentials; block use and report cleanup failure if deletion is refused.[CR]- Reject linked, replaced, foreign-owned and non-regular private files, and restrict saved session headers to public browser preferences.[CR]- Normalize credential field-name variants in logs and preserve safe diagnostic failures and TLS certificate-verification details.[CR]- Keep the current presentation, navigation, genre artwork, pagination and provider playback choices. Restart Kodi after updating the credential service.
